title: Due-Date Window From the HECM Payment Record — Occupancy and Residency Certification
content:
The **due-date window** used in dating a completed certification cycle on an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile is read from the monitored Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) loan's transaction history — its scheduled monthly payments dated on or before the handling date and less than three whole calendar months before it:

| Scheduled monthly payments disbursed in that period | Due-date window |
|---|---|
| three or more | 60 days |
| one or two | 45 days |
| none, or the profile monitors no HECM loan | zero days |

Whole calendar months are counted as anniversaries of the day number, a month being complete only on the same day number of a later month.
